cases.name: AE128-VECTOR-1 (draft sec. 7.2.1, byte for byte)
cases.note: any implementation MUST reproduce this frame byte for byte from the parameters alone and MUST accept it after a round trip; the checker re-derives parse and verification decisions from the frame bytes

cases.name: flags 0x0100 (unassigned bit set)
cases.note: sec. 7.2 step (1) does not list the flags check; support = field row 'flags - unsigned, big-endian; unassigned; sent as 0x0000'. The -03 revision adds flags to the MUST-reject list (author decision 2026-11-09). As frozen, this frame's attestation is invalid (the mutation breaks the MAC), so a receiver that reports only a final rejection passes it for the wrong reason; the parser-isolated variant with a valid attestation is AE-N12.

cases.name: organ tag non-ASCII (0xFF)
cases.note: sec. 7.2 step (1) does not list the organ charset check; support = field row 'organ - exactly 8 octets of US-ASCII'. The -03 revision adds it (author decision 2026-11-09). As frozen, this frame's attestation is invalid (the mutation breaks the MAC), so a receiver that reports only a final rejection passes it for the wrong reason; the parser-isolated variant with a valid attestation is AE-N13.

cases.name: flags 0x0100 (unassigned bit set), valid attestation
cases.note: parser-isolated variant of AE-N07: the attestation is recomputed over this exact frame under the canonical rule (sec. 7.2), so it verifies, and a conformant receiver's rejection can come only from the flags check, whatever order the implementation checks in. -02 does not require the flags check (the step (1) list omits it); the -03 revision adds it (author decision 2026-11-09). An implementation that does not check flags accepts this frame.

cases.name: organ tag non-ASCII (0xFF), valid attestation
cases.note: parser-isolated variant of AE-N11: the attestation is recomputed over this exact frame under the canonical rule (sec. 7.2), so it verifies, and a conformant receiver's rejection can come only from the organ charset check, whatever order the implementation checks in. -02 does not require the organ charset check (the step (1) list omits it); the -03 revision adds it (author decision 2026-11-09). An implementation that does not check the charset accepts this frame.
